title: Creamed Kale Pizza with Lemon, Parmesan and Shallot
changes_from_base: Lemony garlic cream with parmesan and nutmeg is spooned over massaged kale and mozzarella in place of the tomato sauce, and the pizza is shaped into a rectangle and baked on a preheated tray.
summary: Massaged kale under a lemony garlic cream with mozzarella and parmesan, topped with thin shallot rings on a golden rectangular base.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
olive oil, for the baking paper
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Place a rimmed baking tray on the lowest shelf and set the oven to 230 °C.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Combine 120 ml double cream, 15 g parmesan, 15 ml lemon juice, 1 grated garlic clove, ¼ tsp optional nutmeg, ¼ tsp chilli flakes and ¼ tsp salt in a small bowl and stir until smooth.

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: In a medium bowl, rub 115 g curly kale with 15 ml oil and another ¼ tsp salt, squeezing firmly with your hands until the leaves soften.

steps.title: Prepare base
steps.text: Set a tea towel on the work surface, place an inverted tray on top as a makeshift peel, line it with baking paper and brush the paper lightly with 5 ml oil.

steps.title: Stretch
steps.text: Roll or stretch the 450 g dough on the paper to roughly 23 x 33 cm; if it springs back, rest for a few minutes before trying again.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Scatter 115 g grated mozzarella evenly across the base, distribute the wilted kale in an even layer, spoon the cream mixture over the top and crown with the 1 thinly sliced shallot.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pull out the hot tray from below, slide the paper and pizza onto it and bake for 14 to 16 minutes until the cheese and crust are golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Use tongs to transfer the pizza to a cooling rack, leaving the paper behind; rest for a few minutes before cutting.

tips: Squeeze the kale thoroughly with your hands so excess moisture doesn't seep into the crust during baking
Use the hot tray from the lower shelf to set the pizza base quickly and create an extra-crispy bottom
Cavolo nero works in place of curly kale; strip out the tough stalks before chopping.
storage: Keep leftovers chilled and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
